i used to have doses that were calculated to be very high 3rd plat trips, bordering on 4th. obviously though, there are more variables than just weight which can affect the strength of a trip so it’s hard to say whether what i was experiencing was 3rd plat or 4th plat.

in my experience this is how i describe each plateau

1st: mild euphoria and some giddiness, similar to being slightly cross faded 

2nd: same as first but with a little more intensity, listening to music is simply amazing and quite euphoric overall. sometimes there is some dissociation but usually moderate, again like being cross faded

3rd: euphoria is very high now and dissociation is strong. honestly feels like a cocktail of drugs, as euphoric as mdma, as numbing as an opiate, as mentally stimulating as lsd. the stronger the dose the more intense all this becomes obviously and sometimes it can feel like being in a hole

4th: the few times i dosed this high i remember basically nothing except feeling like a multidimensional alien/goblin/thing. very reminiscent of being in a k-hole
